sonnet.problem: The card opens with "Remember the wanderers who couldn't find a city to live in?" and then says the LORD settles "the hungry" in the former desert. This links the hungry of verse 36 to the wanderers of verses 4-5. The text only echoes the wording. It never says they are the same people.
sonnet.rule: **Leave open what the text leaves open:** who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.
